# anthropic_deployment (Data Source)

Get information about a single Deployment by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_deployment" "example" {
  id = "deploy_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Deployment.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the Agent the Deployment runs.
- `agent_version` (String) Version of the Agent the Deployment runs.
- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Deployment was archived, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Deployment was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the Deployment.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the Environment the Deployment runs in.
- `initial_events` (List of String) Initial events sent to the agent on each run, as JSON strings.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the Deployment.
- `name` (String) Name of the Deployment.
- `resources` (List of String) Resources made available to the Deployment, as JSON strings.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Schedule on which the Deployment runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `status` (String) Status of the Deployment.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Deployment was last updated.
- `vault_ids` (List of String) IDs of the Vaults attached to the Deployment.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `expression` (String) Cron expression for the schedule.
- `last_run_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime of the last run.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone of the schedule.
- `upcoming_runs_at` (List of String) RFC 3339 datetimes of upcoming runs.
